questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed here. Regulation signs display rules that all drivers must follow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that a steep hill is coming. Slow down to avoid collisions and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: A Y intersection is ahead. You will need to choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows how high the space is under a bridge or overpass. In this example, the clearance is 12 feet 6 inches.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right, then curves back to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs always mean a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the divided highway is ending. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction areas. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you near schools. Slow down and watch for children crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks an HOV (high occupancy vehicle) lane. Only buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers can use this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a road where traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road has limited clearance above it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns of a divided highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep or long downhill section ahead. The road may also have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a side road intersects with the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down and check for traffic. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and vehicles coming from other directions. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells drivers the road will be slippery when wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Allow other vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians to pass safely before you continue.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the road has many curves ahead. Adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is directing traffic ahead in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards ahead. Round signs are only used to warn of railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter from your current direction. The road is one-way or you are on the wrong side of an expressway ramp.
